cases.subject: DS5301 capstone brief
cases.body: The DS5301 capstone brief asks each team for a four-page design memo covering users, risks, evaluation metrics, and data governance. Submit by 22 October 2026 at 17:00.

expected.action: Submit the DS5301 four-page design memo

cases.subject: DS5301 deadline moved to 24 October
cases.body: The DS5301 design memo deadline has moved from 22 October to 24 October 2026 at 12:00. The page limit and rubric are unchanged.

expected.action: Submit the DS5301 memo by the revised deadline

cases.subject: DS5301 design memo received
cases.body: Your DS5301 design memo was received successfully. Receipt DM-883. Nothing else is needed unless the instructor contacts your team.

cases.subject: Project ORION prototype review
cases.body: For Project ORION, prepare the prototype, test log, and risk register for review on 19 October at 10:00.

cases.subject: Project ORION review accepted
cases.body: The ORION prototype review is accepted. Before launch, only the accessibility check remains; record the result by 27 October.

expected.action: Complete and record the ORION accessibility check

cases.subject: TaskFlow annual plan renews for USD 96
cases.body: Your TaskFlow annual plan renews on 30 October 2026 for USD 96. No action is needed to continue.

cases.subject: TaskFlow card expired
cases.body: The payment card for TaskFlow has expired. Update it by 30 October to prevent the workspace becoming read-only.

cases.subject: Data Ethics seminar invitation
cases.body: The Data Ethics seminar is scheduled for 25 October, 13:00–15:00 in Room L2. Registration is optional.

cases.subject: Data Ethics seminar is now online
cases.body: The Data Ethics seminar remains on 25 October from 13:00–15:00 but will now be online. Registered attendees will receive the link.

cases.subject: Lunch next week?
cases.body: Would you like to have lunch next week? There is no urgency; let me know whenever convenient.
